phase_at_freeze: Before computing any candidate historical states, validation or test results

candidate_grid.rationale: Legacy VIX/curve/leadership seeds; supermajority participation and proposed nested-correlation bands.
Smaller economically visible non-defensive leadership gap.
Require stronger level/momentum for shock; no return optimization.
Require greater co-movement; retain nested-window deterioration definition.
Narrower flat band and earlier material inversion. All are research candidates, not approved defaults.

data_scope.history_source_plan: Existing Yahoo adjusted-close capture pipeline and official Cboe VIX/VX raw archives; no source substitution after candidate outcomes.
data_scope.replay_class: R2 unless exact vintage availability is separately proved; calendar holdouts are not strict PIT OOS.

metrics.occupancy: count/fraction of each classified state; all missing dates reported separately, never dropped from coverage denominator
metrics.persistence: run length in eligible decision sessions; gaps break runs; first/last runs flagged censored
metrics.turnover: changes / adjacent eligible pairs; gaps excluded from pairs but counted as missing
metrics.flip_flop: A-B-A with intervening B lasting <=2 sessions; count / adjacent eligible pairs
metrics.threshold_sensitivity: one-at-a-time +/-10% continuous parameters, +/-1 for integer counts, constrained to frozen domains; disagreement over identical complete dates; report median and worst
metrics.subperiod_stability: annual occupancy, turnover and persistence; changing risk conditions need not have equal occupancies
metrics.regime_differentiation: post-selection diagnostic of contemporaneous/trailing realized volatility, breadth, correlation and VIX; endogenous descriptors, not independent proof or selection objective
metrics.missing_robustness: raw missing, stale, future availability, malformed and degenerate inputs yield honest incomplete states

qualification_criteria.raw_invariants: all raw witnesses and boundaries pass
qualification_criteria.historically_absent_state: flag and distinguish from raw-unreachable; no forced historical witness
qualification_criteria.subperiod_rule: report annual behavior, no equal-occupancy requirement; no editing thresholds in response

selection_rule: On TRAIN only: discard candidates failing any criterion; lexicographic minimum (worst threshold disagreement, turnover, flip-flop, candidate id). No weighted objective. If none pass or coverage insufficient, select none.
validation_rule: Seal training selection and hash before validation; compare all frozen candidates descriptively, never reselect on validation. Failures remain visible.
test_rule: After sealing training selection and validation result, evaluate the selected candidate once on test. No retuning or replacing failed candidates. Report R2 limitations prominently.
walk_forward_rule: Advance the three predetermined folds; a later training fold may consume an earlier test period only chronologically. Final binding, if qualified, is F3 training selection; F1/F2 diagnose drift.
source_attempt_budget: Public official/provider endpoints only; at most one initial attempt plus one retry per archive. No paid data, purchases, credentials or changes to application fetchers.
gate_semantics: Builder readiness means faithful implementability, never production validation. R2 empirical qualification is explicitly limited and cannot open production gate.
